ezekiel.3.p1.b1.text: Son of man … eat what you find here. Eat this scroll, then go and speak to the house of Israel.

ezekiel.3.p1.b2.text: … So I ate, and it was as sweet as honey in my mouth.

ezekiel.3.p1.b3.text: But the house of Israel will be unwilling to listen to you, since they are unwilling to listen to Me. For the whole house of Israel is hard-headed and hard-hearted.

ezekiel.3.p1.b4.text: I will make your forehead like a diamond, harder than flint. Do not be afraid of them or dismayed at their presence, even though they are a rebellious house.

ezekiel.3.p1.b5.text: … speak to them and tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says,’ whether they listen or refuse to listen.

ezekiel.3.p2.b1.text: Blessed be the glory of the LORD in His dwelling place!

ezekiel.3.p2.b2.text: So the Spirit lifted me up and took me away, and I went in bitterness and in the anger of my spirit

ezekiel.3.p2.b3.text: I came to the exiles at Tel-abib who dwelt by the River Kebar. … for seven days I sat where they sat and remained there among them, overwhelmed.

ezekiel.3.p2.b4.text: “Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the house of Israel. Whenever you hear a word from My mouth, give them a warning from Me.

ezekiel.3.p2.b5.text: But if you warn a wicked man and he does not turn from his wickedness and his wicked way … but you will have saved yourself.

ezekiel.3.p3.b1.text: Get up, go out to the plain, and there I will speak with you.

ezekiel.3.p3.b2.text: … the glory of the LORD was present there, like the glory I had seen by the River Kebar, and I fell facedown.

ezekiel.3.p3.b3.text: Go, shut yourself inside your house.

ezekiel.3.p3.b4.text: And you, son of man, they will tie with ropes, and you will be bound so that you cannot go out among the people.

ezekiel.3.p3.b5.text: I will make your tongue stick to the roof of your mouth, and you will be silent

ezekiel.3.p3.b6.text: But when I speak with you, I will open your mouth, and you are to tell them, ‘This is what the Lord GOD says.’
